data.name: Diana
data.message: Heading to medbay for scan, then engines.

I found Charlie's body in medbay just now. My route was security → electrical → medbay. I saw Eve in electrical from tick 7 through 9 — and importantly, I witnessed Eve entering electrical FROM medbay at tick 6. That puts Eve coming straight out of the room where Charlie died, right before I found him. That's very suspicious to me. I'd like to hear Eve explain her movements and what she was doing in medbay.

Diana, your timeline is accurate, but your conclusion is a bit off. I was indeed in medbay, and Charlie was in there with me, perfectly alive and working on a task when I left at tick 6 to head to electrical. Frank was actually in there with us early on too, but he left towards upper engine at tick 2. 

After I left medbay at tick 6, I was doing my tasks in electrical—which you know, because you were in there with me from tick 7 to 9! I couldn't have killed him. The real killer must have slipped into medbay from either the cafeteria or upper engine right after I left. We should be looking at who was near the top left side of the map between ticks 6 and 9. Did anyone pass through cafeteria or upper engine around that time?

My route was oxygen → upper engine → lower engine. I started in oxygen working on a task, then moved down through upper engine to lower engine. I didn't encounter anyone the entire round, which is unfortunate — I have no one to vouch for me and I saw no one to vouch for.

One thing worth noting: Frank, according to Eve, left medbay heading toward upper engine at tick 2. I was in upper engine during my route, and I did NOT see Frank there. That could mean he passed through before I arrived, or it could mean he didn't actually go that way. I'd really like to hear Frank's route — specifically whether he went through upper engine, and when, and whether he doubled back toward medbay.

Eve and Diana corroborate each other from ticks 7-9 in electrical, which gives them mutual alibis for the time Charlie was likely killed. So right now Frank is the person I most want to hear from. Alice too — she hasn't been mentioned at all yet.

Alright, let me lay out my route clearly since Bob asked. I started in electrical, then moved to medbay where I saw Charlie and Eve at tick 2 — both alive, both seemingly working. From medbay I went to upper engine, and then up to oxygen, where I've been finishing my O2 task.

Bob, you said you didn't see me in upper engine — that's worth examining, but the timing could easily explain it. I passed through upper engine on my way to oxygen; if you arrived after I'd already moved up to oxygen, we'd miss each other. The travel times are 2 ticks each leg, so the windows are tight.

Now here's what concerns me about Bob's story: he claims oxygen → upper engine → lower engine, but I was in oxygen finishing my task and I did NOT see Bob there at any point. If Bob started in oxygen, our paths should have overlapped or at least I should have seen him leaving. That's a contradiction worth pressing on.

Meanwhile, Diana and Eve mutually confirm each other from ticks 7-9 in electrical — that's a solid alibi for both during the likely kill window. Charlie was alive at tick 2 with me and Eve, Eve left to electrical at tick 6, Diana found the body after.

The person without an alibi AND whose story conflicts with mine is Bob. I'm voting Bob.

Wait, I think there's some confusion about speaker order — I already gave my initial report. But since I have the floor again, let me address what's been said.

Frank's accusation against Bob is interesting, but I want to point out something: Frank places himself in medbay at tick 2 with Charlie and Eve, then claims he moved to upper engine and then oxygen. Eve corroborates Frank being in medbay early and leaving toward upper engine at tick 2. So Frank's early presence in medbay is confirmed by Eve.

However, Frank and Bob's stories directly conflict about oxygen — they can't both be telling the truth about being there without seeing each other. One of them is lying, or the timing genuinely just missed.

My alibi with Eve from ticks 7-9 in electrical is solid — we vouch for each other during the likely kill window. That means the killer is Alice, Bob, or Frank.

Alice hasn't said anything, which is deeply concerning. I'd really like Alice to speak up before we vote. Between Bob and Frank, I'm not ready to commit — but Alice's silence is the biggest red flag right now.

Diana, I appreciate you confirming our timeline. That mutual alibi from ticks 7 to 9 really clears both of us, as Charlie had to have been killed in that window after I left medbay. 

With us cleared, we have to look at the massive contradiction between Bob and Frank. Bob claims he started in oxygen, but Frank was in oxygen finishing a task and never saw him. Since I can personally verify Frank's early route—he really was in medbay at tick 2 and headed toward upper engine—I am far more inclined to believe Frank's timeline over Bob's. It's very possible Bob fabricated his entire route to cover up slipping into medbay while you and I were in electrical. 

Alice's silence is also terrible, but the hard mechanical contradiction lies with Bob. I'm going to follow Frank's logic on this one. I'm voting for Bob.

I need to push back hard here because I'm being railroaded. Let me be clear about my route again: I started in oxygen, moved to upper engine, then to lower engine. 

Frank, you claim you were in oxygen "finishing your O2 task" and never saw me. But think about this carefully — your stated route is electrical → medbay (tick 2) → upper engine → oxygen. With 2-tick travel times, you wouldn't arrive in oxygen until around tick 6 at earliest. I was in oxygen at the START of the round and left for upper engine early. So us missing each other in oxygen is completely consistent with timing — I was leaving as you were still making your way there via medbay and upper engine.

But here's the bigger issue: if Frank truly went medbay → upper engine → oxygen, he would have passed through upper engine, where I was. I didn't see him there either. So the "contradiction" cuts both ways — and timing windows explain both.

Now consider this: Frank is the LAST person confirmed alive with Charlie in medbay. Eve says she left at tick 6, but Frank claims he left medbay at tick 2 toward upper engine. What if Frank doubled back? Medbay connects to upper engine directly — he could have looped back to medbay after Eve left and killed Charlie, then claimed to be in oxygen.

I know Alice's silence is suspicious, and I share that concern. But I am NOT the killer, and Frank is pushing the vote on me very aggressively while having a route that's hard to verify. I want to hear Alice before anyone votes.

I'm sorry for the silence earlier — I genuinely had nothing useful to add and I didn't want to muddy the waters. Let me lay out my round now.

My route was simple: navigation → storage. I was working tasks the whole time and I did not encounter a single other player. I have no alibi and no one to vouch for, just like Bob. I know that's not satisfying, but it's the truth.

Now, on the actual analysis: Diana and Eve mutually confirm each other from ticks 7–9 in electrical, which I'm inclined to accept as a real alibi for the kill window. That leaves me, Bob, and Frank.

I want to push back gently on the Bob pile-on. Bob's point about timing is actually fair — if he left oxygen early and Frank arrived later via medbay → upper engine → oxygen, they could legitimately miss each other. That's not a hard contradiction, that's just tight windows on a 2-tick map.

What I find more interesting is this: Frank places himself in medbay at tick 2 with Charlie, which Eve confirms. Frank then claims he went upper engine → oxygen. Bob says he was in upper engine and did NOT see Frank pass through. That's the same kind of "timing" excuse Frank used against Bob — it cuts both ways, exactly as Bob said.

Frank is also pushing very hard and very fast to lock in a Bob vote. That aggression from someone who was last confirmed near the victim makes me uneasy. Bob's doubleback theory on Frank — medbay → upper engine → back to medbay after Eve left — is mechanically possible.

I'm leaning Frank, but I'd honestly be okay hearing one more round. If we must vote now, my vote goes to Frank.

Alright, I've heard everyone now, and I want to address Alice's pivot directly because it's important.

Alice, you're framing the Bob/Frank situation as symmetric — "timing cuts both ways." But it doesn't, and here's why: Eve independently confirmed I was in medbay at tick 2 and left toward upper engine. That's a verified starting point for my route. Bob has ZERO corroboration for any part of his route. He claims oxygen → upper engine → lower engine and saw literally no one the entire game. That's not the same as my situation at all.

On the "doubleback" theory Bob floated: if I had doubled back to medbay from upper engine, I would have had to wait there or loop around while Eve was still in medbay until tick 6, then kill Charlie, then somehow get to oxygen in time. That's a very tight, very suspicious path — and it leaves me with no completed task. I'm in oxygen finishing my O2 task right now, which is verifiable.

Alice, your route — navigation → storage — also has no witnesses. You and Bob are in identical positions: no alibi, no encounters. But you spent your speech defending Bob and pivoting the vote to me, the person whose early movements were confirmed by a cleared player (Eve). That's a classic deflection pattern.

Diana and Eve are cleared. I was confirmed in medbay early by Eve and am completing a task in oxygen. That leaves Alice and Bob as the real suspects, and Alice's late-game pivot to push me concerns me more than Bob's defensive scrambling.

I'm voting Alice.

data.name: Alice
data.message: Heading to weapons for my last task, want to come?

I just found Diana's body in upper engine. My route this round was navigation → security → weapons → cafeteria → oxygen → upper engine. I didn't see anyone along the way except early on — Charlie and Eve were both in medbay at tick 2.

With Bob, Charlie, and Diana all dead, that leaves just me, Alice, and Eve alive. One of them is the Duck. I was nowhere near upper engine until the very end, and I had no contact with Diana before finding her dead.

Eve — where were you after medbay? And Alice, where have you been this whole round? One of you killed Diana, and we need to figure out which one before the Duck gets majority.

Frank, you're right about early on — I was in Medbay. After that, I did a big loop on the right side of the ship: Electrical, Security, Weapons, and then Cafeteria. 

Just before the meeting was called, I headed back down to Electrical to finish my Calibrate task. Literally a second before your meeting popped up, I walked in and found Bob's dead body on the floor! I didn't even have time to hit the report button. 

Since I was way down in Electrical finding Bob, I was nowhere near Upper Engine where you found Diana. Frank, I'm willing to believe you just stumbled on Diana's body, which means the Duck has been on a killing spree. Alice, you've been a total ghost this entire round. I haven't seen you anywhere. We really need to hear your route, because right now it has to be you.

Okay, I need to lay this out carefully because I'm the deciding voice here.

My route was: oxygen → upper engine → medbay → cafeteria → weapons. 

Here's what I saw: At tick 17, I watched Diana LEAVE medbay heading to upper engine — that's where Frank says he found her body. Then at tick 18, Bob entered medbay from storage, and I was with Bob in medbay for ticks 18, 19, and 20 doing tasks. Bob was alive when I left medbay heading to cafeteria.

Now here's the problem with Eve's story. Eve claims her route was Medbay → Electrical → Security → Weapons → Cafeteria → back to Electrical where she found Bob. But I was in medbay from tick 18-20 and I did NOT see Eve there. She says she was in medbay early — fine, that matches Frank — but if she looped through Weapons, I should have seen her in Weapons at the end, and I didn't. I'm in Weapons right now and have been.

Also, Eve found Bob's body in Electrical — but Bob was alive in medbay with me at tick 20. For Bob to die in Electrical, someone had to be near him after I left. Eve's "I just walked in and found him" is awfully convenient.

Frank's route is consistent and he found Diana where I literally saw Diana walking to. Eve's story has Bob dying in Electrical right when she happened to arrive.

I'm voting Eve.

Alice laid it out well. My route was navigation → security → weapons → cafeteria → oxygen → upper engine, and I found Diana dead the moment I arrived in upper engine. I only saw Charlie and Eve in medbay at tick 2, nothing else the entire round.

Alice's information is critical: she was with Bob in medbay through tick 20, and she was in weapons at the end — which lines up with me passing through weapons earlier and then her being there when I left for cafeteria. Actually, wait — I was in weapons before cafeteria, and I don't recall seeing Alice there at that moment, but our timing could easily have missed by a tick or two.

The key issue is Eve's story. She claims a loop of Electrical → Security → Weapons → Cafeteria → back to Electrical. That's a lot of ground, and if she was in weapons at any point near the end, Alice should have seen her. Alice didn't. And Eve conveniently "finding" Bob's body in electrical right as I called my meeting is suspicious — it means she can't be made to report it and be scrutinized.

I'm leaning Eve. Vote Eve.

Frank, please think about this carefully—Alice is playing you, and her story is full of holes. She claims she was in Weapons at the end of the round, but you yourself just realized that you passed through Weapons and didn't see her there! That’s because she wasn't in Weapons. 

Alice admits she was the last person with Bob in Medbay. She claims she left him alive, but she had plenty of time to follow him down to Electrical, kill him, and then make up this fake alibi about being in Weapons. That's why neither of us saw her there. 

She's trying to use your route against me by acting like her story perfectly aligns with yours, but the fact that you two never crossed paths in Weapons proves she's lying. If she was in Weapons, you would have seen her. She was in Electrical killing Bob while I was making my loop. 

Frank, if you vote for me, she wins the game right now. She is the only one who had confirmed contact with Bob right before he died. We have to vote Alice!

Eve, nice try, but you're twisting Frank's words. Frank said his timing with me in weapons "could easily have missed by a tick or two" — he went weapons → cafeteria → oxygen → upper engine. That's at least 6 ticks between him being in weapons and now. I arrived in weapons AFTER he left. There's no contradiction.

Meanwhile, you still haven't explained why I didn't see you in medbay during ticks 18-20 when you claim you looped back through that area, and you haven't explained how Bob conveniently died in Electrical right as you "arrived." 

And here's the kicker: if I killed Bob in Electrical, I'd have to travel medbay → electrical → weapons, which is a long path. I went medbay → cafeteria → weapons, which Frank's own route corroborates because he was in cafeteria around when I would have been passing through.

You're the only one whose story doesn't add up. I'm voting Eve. Frank, please stay with me on this.
